drivers.access_and_room: No track or road reaches the pin; it sits on a bare forested slope above a building's car park, with no way for a van to drive in.
drivers.seclusion: The only spot a van could actually stop is the adjoining sealed car park, hard against a large building with windows overlooking it.
drivers.traffic: The car park serves an active facility (oval/courts visible, cars parked) so daytime traffic is likely, though it would be quiet at night.
